senses.gloss: --a daughter of Puloma, consort of Indra and mother of Jayanta. Br. II. १३. ७९; III 6. २३; M. 6. २१; वा. ६८. २२, २४.

--इन्द्राणी, took सत्यभामा as a human being and did not accord her due treatment; did not wish to part with पारिजात which Satya wanted; induced Indra to fight कृष्ण who was taking the पारिजात. Vi. V. ३०. २९ and ५२.
--see Indra; got कृष्ण's promise of protection to Arjuna. Vi. V. १२. १५; १२. १६-20, २४. [page३-507+ २९]

--ministers, consulted by तारक before his war with the devas;
1: M. १४८. ३१.
of a State.
2: Ib. २१६. २५.
